protocol.selection: Next three chronological Grands Prix; all earlier inspected races now development data
protocol.interval_calibration: Equal-race weighted development 90th percentile of absolute standardized residuals; empirical, no exchangeability guarantee
protocol.limitations: Median warm-start, clipped updates and gap resets are robust heuristics, not exact Bayesian inference; gaps are not proof of race interruptions; retrospective quality filters retained
